verdict.rationale: Codegen agents create branches, commit code, and open PRs, and the agent itself can review PRs and post comments, but the evidence pack does not show a dedicated human-in-the-loop diff review/approval gate before a PR is created — the CLI lets you 'pull agent work' locally which could support manual review, but no explicit approval workflow is documented. missing for 10: explicit pre-PR diff approval UI/workflow, evidence of a human approve/reject gate, independent confirmation that PR creation is blocked pending review.
